comment: Canonical SRAM22 pin interface. The pin-list table renders from this file, and scripts/check-docs.mjs verifies it against the LEF pin emitter in src/abs.rs. Keep widths as expression names so they stay parametric.

pins.name: clk
pins.purpose: Clock. Address, data, and access controls are captured on the rising edge; dout updates after a read. Physical reset is asynchronous.

pins.name: rstb
pins.purpose: Asynchronous active-low physical reset of control state and input flops. Inhibits accesses; does not initialize stored memory or dout.

pins.name: ce
pins.purpose: Chip enable. When high, a read or write occurs on the rising clock edge; when low, the array is idle and retains data.

pins.name: we
pins.purpose: Write enable. With ce high, we=1 performs a write and we=0 performs a read.

pins.name: wmask
pins.purpose: Bit i enables writing data bits [i·write_size +: write_size]. Always present; scalar when write_size equals data_width.

pins.name: din
pins.purpose: Write data input, sampled on the rising edge during a write.

pins.name: dout
pins.purpose: Read data output. Valid after the clk-to-Q delay following a read; holds until the next read.
